slides.headline: What Microsoft's AI chief admits about your work
Microsoft AI CEO speaks out
slides.body: Mustafa Suleyman told BBC this week that AI training on creative work is theft

slides.headline: His exact words
slides.body: "Largest theft of labor in human history" — describing how models learn from artists and writers

slides.headline: Your content was likely taken
slides.body: Photos, blogs, art, and code scraped from the open web without asking or paying anyone

slides.headline: Microsoft still uses that data
slides.body: Copilot and other products run on the same training he just called stolen labor

slides.headline: Follow for AI ethics
slides.body: We cover who profits and who loses when AI takes your work
